run.note: Fixture run: the server replayed canned replies about a different song, so these numbers measure the plumbing (requests, streaming, parsing, scoring), not the model.

byTune.title: Joyful, Joyful, We Adore Thee (Hymn to Joy)
byTune.case: The demo tune's melody in a hymnal harmonization: the easy case.

byTune.title: O Come, O Come, Emmanuel (Veni Emmanuel)
byTune.case: Relative-key ambiguity: an E minor melody whose setting leans on G major.

byTune.title: God Rest Ye Merry, Gentlemen
byTune.case: Minor key with a raised leading tone (D#) in the half cadence.
